$comment: 编辑用分块，由 build.py 拼进 request.schema.json。

setParaTextOp.descriptionEn: Change the text in one paragraph.
setParaTextOp.limits: 找不到该段落报 IdNotFound。不插入、不删除段落。多个 run 时只留第一个 run 已有的 w:rPr，其余 run 的字符格式去掉。对页眉或页脚容器 id（没有 /para:）报 InvalidId。该段里的 w:drawing 必须留下，包括只剩绘图、已经被清掉 w:t 的 run。
setParaTextOp.limitsEn: A missing paragraph returns IdNotFound. Paragraphs are not inserted or deleted. When there are several runs, only the first run's existing w:rPr stays, and character formatting on the other runs is dropped. A header or footer container id (one without /para:) returns InvalidId. w:drawing in that paragraph must stay, including a run that has only the drawing and whose w:t has already been cleared.

setParaRunsOp.description: 按原文把已有段落拆成多个 run。短的用 match。中间很长时只写 after 和 before 两个切点。
setParaRunsOp.descriptionEn: Split an existing paragraph into runs from the original text. Use match for a short span. For a long span, give only the after and before cut points.
setParaRunsOp.limits: 不改没点名的字，不重建文件。不写 match 时，after 是左切点，before 是右切点，中间原文单独成一截，中间不用抄。重复时用 nth。text 连起来必须和现在的可见文字相同。
setParaRunsOp.limitsEn: Does not change unnamed words and does not rebuild the file. Without match, after is the left cut and before is the right cut; the text between them becomes the run and is not copied into the request. Use nth when the pair repeats. text pieces must join to the current visible text.

insertBookmarkOp.description: 在起始段 w:pPr 之后插入 w:bookmarkStart，在结束段末尾插入配对 w:bookmarkEnd。
insertBookmarkOp.descriptionEn: Insert w:bookmarkStart after the start paragraph's w:pPr, and insert the matching w:bookmarkEnd at the end of the end paragraph.
insertBookmarkOp.limits: w:id 取该部件已有书签 id 的最大整数加 1，至少为 0。name 不能为空、不能含空白、不能以 _ 开头，否则报 InvalidField。与已有书签名（含隐藏书签）冲突报 InvalidField。end 必须与 id 在同一故事，且文档顺序不得早于起始段，否则报 InvalidField。找不到段落报 IdNotFound。id / end 不是段落 id 报 InvalidId。
insertBookmarkOp.limitsEn: w:id is one greater than the largest existing bookmark id in that part, and at least 0. name must not be empty, must not contain whitespace, and must not start with _, otherwise InvalidField. A clash with an existing bookmark name, including hidden bookmarks, returns InvalidField. end must be in the same story as id, and must not precede the start paragraph in document order, otherwise InvalidField. A missing paragraph returns IdNotFound. An id or end that is not a paragraph id returns InvalidId.

setBookmarkOp.limits: 同时把本部件里 w:hyperlink/@w:anchor 等于旧名的改成新名。新名规则与 insertBookmark 相同。与其他书签重名报 InvalidField。已经是该名则空操作，仍计入 opsApplied。找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是书签 id 报 InvalidId。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
setBookmarkOp.limitsEn: Also change w:hyperlink/@w:anchor in this part from the old name to the new name. New-name rules match insertBookmark. A name already used by another bookmark returns InvalidField. If it is already that name, this is a no-op and is still counted in opsApplied. A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a bookmark id returns InvalidId. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

deleteBookmarkOp.description: 去掉配对的 w:bookmarkStart 与 w:bookmarkEnd。
deleteBookmarkOp.descriptionEn: Remove the matching pair of w:bookmarkStart and w:bookmarkEnd.
deleteBookmarkOp.limits: 不改指向该书签的 w:hyperlink/@w:anchor。找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是书签 id 报 InvalidId。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
deleteBookmarkOp.limitsEn: Does not change w:hyperlink/@w:anchor that points at that bookmark. A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a bookmark id returns InvalidId. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

docxInsertFieldOp.description: 在该段已有内容之后插入一组复杂域：fldChar begin（w:dirty="true"）、一条 instrText（xml:space="preserve"）、fldChar separate、 若给了非空 result 则再写一个带 w:t 的 run、fldChar end。
docxInsertFieldOp.descriptionEn: After the paragraph's existing content, insert one complex field: fldChar begin (w:dirty="true"), one instrText (xml:space="preserve"), fldChar separate, then a run with w:t if a non-empty result was given, then fldChar end.
docxInsertFieldOp.limits: 给了窗体 code 时在 begin 里写 w:ffData，不写书签。不在库里求值。空 instr / 空 code / 同时给两者 / 两个都不给 / 不认识的 code / 缺 arg，报 InvalidField。
docxInsertFieldOp.limitsEn: When a form code is given, write w:ffData on begin and do not write a bookmark. This library does not evaluate the field. An empty instr, an empty code, giving both, giving neither, an unrecognized code, or a missing arg returns InvalidField.

docxSetFieldOp.description: 只改被点名那一域的指令，不改缓存结果，也不改 ffData。
docxSetFieldOp.descriptionEn: Change only the instruction of the named field. The cached result is not changed, and ffData is not changed.
docxSetFieldOp.limits: 简单域写 w:instr。复杂域删掉本层指令区里的旧 instrText 以及落在指令区里的嵌套域，在 begin 之后插入一条新的 instrText。结果区（separate 与 end 之间）不动。不在库里求值。instr 缺或只含空白报 InvalidField。找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是域 id 报 InvalidId。xlsx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
docxSetFieldOp.limitsEn: A simple field writes w:instr. A complex field deletes the old instrText in this level's instruction range and any nested fields that fall in that instruction range, then inserts one new instrText after begin. The result range (between separate and end) is left unchanged. This library does not evaluate the field. A missing instr, or one that is only whitespace, returns InvalidField. A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a field id returns InvalidId. This op on xlsx returns InvalidField.

docxDeleteFieldOp.description: keep 为 result：拆掉该域外壳与指令，留下缓存结果。
docxDeleteFieldOp.descriptionEn: When keep is result: unwrap the field shell and the instruction, and keep the cached result.
docxDeleteFieldOp.limits: 指令区里的嵌套域一并删掉；结果区里的嵌套域留下。简单域拆掉 w:fldSimple，留下子节点。keep 为 instr：把本层指令变成普通可见文本（instrText 改成 w:t，简单域则写成一个带指令原文的 run），删掉 begin / separate / end 与结果区。指令区里的嵌套域留下。找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是域 id 报 InvalidId。xlsx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
docxDeleteFieldOp.limitsEn: Nested fields in the instruction range are deleted along with it; nested fields in the result range stay. A simple field unwraps w:fldSimple and keeps its children. When keep is instr: turn this level's instruction into ordinary visible text (instrText becomes w:t; a simple field is written as a run that contains the instruction text), and delete begin / separate / end and the result range. Nested fields in the instruction range stay. A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a field id returns InvalidId. This op on xlsx returns InvalidField.

setParaNumberingOp.description: num 为实例 id 时写入（或改写）w:numPr，插在 pStyle 之后。
setParaNumberingOp.descriptionEn: When num is an instance id, write or replace w:numPr, inserted after pStyle.
setParaNumberingOp.limits: 找不到该编号实例报 IdNotFound。num 为 null 时去掉 numPr，不要求 numbering 部件存在。缺 num 报 InvalidField。ilvl 超出 0–8 报 InvalidField。找不到段落报 IdNotFound。id 不是正文或页眉页脚段落 id 报 InvalidId。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
setParaNumberingOp.limitsEn: A missing numbering instance returns IdNotFound. When num is null, numPr is removed, and the numbering part need not exist. A missing num returns InvalidField. An ilvl outside 0–8 returns InvalidField. A missing paragraph returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a body or header/footer paragraph id returns InvalidId. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

setParaStyleOp.description: style 为样式 id 时写入（或改写）w:pStyle，放在 pPr 子元素最前。
setParaStyleOp.descriptionEn: When style is a style id, write or replace w:pStyle, placed first among the pPr children.
setParaStyleOp.limits: 目标必须已在 styles.xml 里，且是段落样式。字符 / 表格 / 编号样式报 InvalidField。找不到该样式报 IdNotFound。style 为 null 时去掉 pStyle，不要求 styles 部件存在。缺 style 报 InvalidField。找不到段落报 IdNotFound。id 不是正文或页眉页脚段落 id 报 InvalidId。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
setParaStyleOp.limitsEn: The target must already be in styles.xml and must be a paragraph style. A character, table, or numbering style returns InvalidField. A missing style returns IdNotFound. When style is null, pStyle is removed, and the styles part need not exist. A missing style field returns InvalidField. A missing paragraph returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a body or header/footer paragraph id returns InvalidId. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

setRunStyleOp.description: style 为样式 id 时写入（或改写）w:rStyle，放在 rPr 子元素最前（EG_RPrBase）。
setRunStyleOp.descriptionEn: When style is a style id, write or replace w:rStyle, placed first among the rPr children (EG_RPrBase).
setRunStyleOp.limits: 目标必须已在 styles.xml 里，且是字符样式。段落 / 表格 / 编号样式报 InvalidField。找不到该样式报 IdNotFound。style 为 null 时去掉 rStyle，不要求 styles 部件存在。缺 style 报 InvalidField。找不到 run 报 IdNotFound。id 不是 run id 报 InvalidId。框内 / 注内 / 批注内 run 报 InvalidId。
setRunStyleOp.limitsEn: The target must already be in styles.xml and must be a character style. A paragraph, table, or numbering style returns InvalidField. A missing style returns IdNotFound. When style is null, rStyle is removed, and the styles part need not exist. A missing style field returns InvalidField. A missing run returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a run id returns InvalidId. A run inside a text box, note, or comment returns InvalidId.

setParaFormatOp.description: 改段落的对齐、缩进和间距。
setParaFormatOp.descriptionEn: Change a paragraph's alignment, indent, and spacing.
setParaFormatOp.limits: align、left、right、firstLine、hanging、before、after、line、lineRule、 kinsoku、overflowPunct、topLinePunct、autoSpaceDE、autoSpaceDN、borders、shd、tabs 至少给一个。 firstLine 与 hanging 不能同时写成非 null 的数字。不认识的 align / lineRule 报 InvalidField。只改该段自己的 w:pPr，不改 styles.xml。 属性删光后去掉空的 w:ind / w:spacing。
setParaFormatOp.limitsEn: Provide at least one of align, left, right, firstLine, hanging, before, after, line, lineRule, kinsoku, overflowPunct, topLinePunct, autoSpaceDE, autoSpaceDN, borders, shd, and tabs. firstLine and hanging cannot both be written as non-null numbers. An unrecognized align or lineRule returns InvalidField. Only that paragraph's own w:pPr is changed; styles.xml is not changed. After the attributes are all removed, an empty w:ind or w:spacing is removed.

setRunFormatOp.description: 改一段文字的字体、颜色和字号。
setRunFormatOp.descriptionEn: Change the font, color, and size of a run of text.
setRunFormatOp.limits: bold、italic、underline、sz、color、font、eastAsiaFont、em、eastAsianLayout、highlight、strike、dstrike、vertAlign、spacing、kern、scale 至少给一个。只改被点名的那一个 w:r 的 w:rPr，不拆 run，不改 styles.xml。
setRunFormatOp.limitsEn: Provide at least one of bold, italic, underline, sz, color, font, eastAsiaFont, em, eastAsianLayout, highlight, strike, dstrike, vertAlign, spacing, kern, and scale. Only w:rPr on the named w:r is changed. The run is not split, and styles.xml is not changed.
